extends.source: Thesis #3 Disease Profile contract. This file adds observation channels. It does not edit that contract.

disease_label: Unspecified solid-tumour class, the usual target label of a fused platform story

answers.question: Who is asking?
answers.label: A methods researcher encoding a compartmental concept

answers.question: Which disease, not a generic cancer slogan?
answers.label: An unspecified solid-tumour class. No person and no stage.

answers.question: What is the current regime?
answers.label: An in-vitro concept. No clinical regime is asserted.

answers.question: Where is the system stuck?
answers.label: Photothermal or ROS action, exosome delivery, and Raman sensing are told as one platform story.

observables.statement: Individual exosome-like vesicles have been identified by surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy in published experiments.
Chitosan-coated triangular silver nanoparticles have been reported as photothermal transducers in an in-vitro cell assay.
Tumour exosome-based nanoparticles have been reported as drug carriers in a chemotherapy study.

observation_channels.name: SERS or Raman reporter
observation_channels.observes: A declared spectral contrast or reporter occupancy
observation_channels.refusal: Spectral contrast stays out of the damage coefficient and out of any dose.

observation_channels.name: Exosome compartment label
observation_channels.observes: A score of cargo in the medium compartment or the cell-associated compartment
observation_channels.refusal: A tropism sentence stays out of a delivery-rate parameter.

observation_channels.name: Photothermal or ROS assay readout
observation_channels.observes: A temperature or ROS assay number from a declared in-vitro setup
observation_channels.refusal: An assay number stays out of a laser protocol and out of an infused dose.

candidate_mechanisms.statement: Reporter gain, compartment score, and damage-assay coefficient are three symbols.
candidate_mechanisms.falsifier: A preparation series whose reporter loading, compartment indicator, and damage loading are not the same vector, and whose three readouts nevertheless share one coefficient within error.

candidate_mechanisms.statement: The AgNP-exosome-Raman platform works as nanotherapy.
candidate_mechanisms.refusal_rule: Empty falsifier and a therapeutic prediction.

non_parameters.statement: One symbol used as the Raman gain and as the damage coefficient.
A Raman peak height copied into a killing coefficient.
A sentence about tumour tropism written as a delivery rate.
A surface-plasmon peak from green synthesis treated as anticancer efficacy.
A laser fluence or an infusion written as a parameter of this object.
The word theranostic used as a quantity.

admitted_hypotheses.statement: A Raman reporter gain and a damage-assay coefficient are different symbols, and neither is a therapeutic parameter of this profile.
admitted_hypotheses.falsifier: Preparations in which the reporter loading and the damage loading are not proportional, if the two readouts then collapse to one coefficient.
